text: Before any pipeline gets built, V1 needs a hard written line around what it actually ships.
V1 answers questions grounded in exactly three document sets: hr-policies, it-wiki, and ops-sops. Nothing more.
It doesn't connect to every system at Wrenfield, it doesn't take actions like resetting a VPN, and it doesn't replace judgment calls HR, IT, or Ops staff have to make.
Those are real, deferred next steps -- named on purpose, not forgotten.
Next: the first real architecture decision -- choosing the actual stack.
